criteria_results.criterion_text: `src/uptime/__init__.py`, `src/uptime/router.py`, `src/uptime/schemas.py` exist; router registered in `src/main.py` with tag `uptime`
criteria_results.evidence: All three files exist in src/uptime/. The router is imported in src/main.py (line 19: `from src.uptime.router import router as uptime_router`) and registered at line 98 (`app.include_router(uptime_router, tags=["uptime"])`). The openapi_tags list includes the uptime tag (lines 74-77). Verified by TestUptimeRouterRegistration tests.

criteria_results.criterion_text: `GET /uptime` returns 200 with exactly the three fields `service`, `started_at`, `uptime_seconds`
criteria_results.evidence: Test test_uptime_returns_200 verifies HTTP 200 status. Test test_uptime_response_has_exactly_three_fields asserts that response.json() keys equal {'service', 'started_at', 'uptime_seconds'} with no extra or missing fields.

criteria_results.criterion_text: `service` equals `settings.app_name`; `started_at` parses as ISO-8601 with UTC offset; `uptime_seconds` is a float >= 0
criteria_results.evidence: Test test_uptime_service_matches_app_name asserts data['service'] == settings.app_name. Test test_uptime_started_at_is_iso8601_with_utc_offset parses the value via datetime.fromisoformat() and asserts tzinfo and utcoffset are not None. Test test_uptime_uptime_seconds_is_float_and_non_negative asserts isinstance(data['uptime_seconds'], float) and data['uptime_seconds'] >= 0.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Two sequential requests: second `uptime_seconds` > first; `started_at` identical in both
criteria_results.evidence: Test test_uptime_sequential_requests_increasing_uptime makes two GET requests with a 50ms sleep, asserts data2['uptime_seconds'] > data1['uptime_seconds']. Test test_uptime_started_at_identical_across_requests makes two requests with a 50ms sleep, asserts data1['started_at'] == data2['started_at']. The _startup_time module-level variable ensures started_at is fixed at import time.

Test test_uptime_post_returns_405 sends a POST request to /uptime and asserts response.status_code == HTTPStatus.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED (405). FastAPI automatically returns 405 for methods not defined on an endpoint.

criteria_results.criterion_text: `src/uptime/` contains no import of `src.db` (no database coupling) — asserted by a test
criteria_results.evidence: Test test_uptime_no_db_import reads all .py files in src/uptime/ and asserts 'src.db' is not in any file content. Test test_uptime_router_no_db_dependency reads router.py source and asserts neither 'from src.db' nor 'import src.db' appears. The router.py only imports from src.core.config and src.uptime.schemas.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Tests live in `tests/test_uptime.py` following the existing test conventions; full suite has zero net-new failures
criteria_results.evidence: Tests are in tests/test_uptime.py using class-based naming (TestUptimeEndpoint, TestUptimeSchema, TestUptimeNoDatabaseCoupling, TestUptimeRouterRegistration) consistent with existing patterns. All 15 uptime tests pass. The 9 pre-existing failures in test_middleware.py and test_alembic.py are due to PostgreSQL connectivity issues and are not net-new from this feature.

criteria_results.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
criteria_results.evidence: ruff check on src/uptime/ and tests/test_uptime.py returned 'All checks passed!'. ruff format --check confirmed all 4 files already formatted. Zero lint or format errors.
